narrative.offerRewardText: There you are, adventurer.  A fair trade.  Enjoy.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, I must thank you for all your help.  I have plenty of supplies, through no small efforts on your part, but if you wish to bring me more armor kits, then I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.
